subject: Leadership demo — VP/CIO presence & coverage ask
messages:
From: Ava Monroe <ava.monroe@stratonics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stratonics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership demo — VP/CIO presence request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this forward. We reviewed Redwood with the product team and our VP of Engineering and CIO have both flagged this as high priority — they want a short executive intro followed by a technical deep dive. Can you confirm VP/CIO attendance for one of these windows next week?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 26 May, 14:00–15:00

Our ask: 15 min from your VP/lead (brief business value + fit) + 45 min technical demo with our CIO. If VP/CIO can't both attend, we need a named backup who can speak to roadmap and contract/timing.

I've attached our signed NDA (stub). Also looping in Samir from procurement — he may have follow-up on terms.

Thanks,
Ava

--
Ava Monroe
Director of Product Strategy
Stratonics

Attachments: Stratonics-NDA-signed.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Monroe <ava.monroe@stratonics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership demo — VP/CIO presence request

Hi Ava — really appreciate the quick clarity.

We can lock the Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:00 PT slot. I'll escalate to our Head of Product and ask if the VP can join the first 15 minutes for the business overview. If the VP is unavailable, Grace will cover with a short roadmap/impact brief and I will join the technical portion. Priyom will own the procurement signal and follow the DocuSign/term questions.

Quick agenda (proposed):
- 10:00–10:15: Executive intro & go/no-go signals (VP or Grace)
- 10:15–10:55: Technical demo (connectors, throughput, latency, dedicated/private options)
- 10:55–11:00: Next steps & procurement action items

Recording: we can record the full session if you prefer — let us know if your execs want parts off the record.

I've provisionally created a calendar hold (link below). I will confirm final attendee list by EOD Friday and share the run-of-show PDF.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-demo-4821
Run of show (preview): https://redwood.app/runofshow/DEAL-4821

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: demo-run-of-show-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ava Monroe <ava.monroe@stratonics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stratonics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership demo — VP/CIO presence request

Marcus — thanks, Tue 25th works great. We prefer the VP to be present for the first 15 mins; our CIO will be on for the technical portion.

Recording: okay to record, but our VP would like the Q&A (10:45–11:00) to be off-camera — can you confirm we can pause recording for that segment?

Samir — quick question for procurement: we'll need a preliminary SOW estimate before the exec call; can you share any standard template or expectations?

Attaching the NDA you referenced (signed) and a short procurement intake form (stub). I'll send calendar RSVPs once we have the final attendee list.

Appreciate the coordination — see you on the 25th.

—Ava

> On Wed, May 19, 2027 at 10:06 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> > We can lock the Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:00 PT slot. I'll escalate to our Head of Product...

Attachments: Stratonics-NDA-signed.pdf (application/pdf), procurement-intake-form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Monroe <ava.monroe@stratonics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership demo — VP/CIO presence request

Thanks — quick note from me: if the VP has a conflict, I'll take the 10:00–10:15 slot and make sure the roadmap slice covers timing and escalation points relevant to procurement (cost buckets, Dedicated vs Hosted options). Marcus, please include a one-slide summary for the VP (3 bullets: business outcomes, timeline, ask).

Priyom — happy to hand off any procurement questions directly; can you prep a short pricing/commitment matrix we can drop into the run-of-show?

I'll mark myself as backup on the calendar hold. 

Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Marketing — Redwood Inference

> On Wed, May 19, 2027 at 10:06 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I've provisionally created a calendar hold (link below). I will confirm final attendee list by EOD Friday and share the run-of-show PDF.

Subject: Re: Leadership demo — VP/CIO presence & coverage ask

Perfect — Grace, will add the one-slide summary and the pricing matrix stub. Priyom, if you can drop the matrix by Friday morning I'll stitch it into the run-of-show. Ava/Samir — expect the calendar invite with final attendees by Friday EOD.

Thanks all,
Marcus
